_comment: Вакансии правятся вручную здесь. Удалите блок — исчезнет с сайта. notice можно очистить, когда появятся настоящие вакансии.
intro: We do not list everything. A handful of roles a week in catering, cabin product, IFEC and duty free — the ones actually worth moving for. Junior, agency-reposted and vague listings do not make the page.
notice: Sample listings. These entries are placeholders showing the layout — company names are generic on purpose. Replace with real vacancies before launch.

roles.title: Head of Inflight Catering
roles.why: Owns the catering budget for a 250-aircraft fleet — one of maybe twenty jobs like it in the world.

roles.title: Cabin Product Manager — Long Haul
roles.why: Sits at the centre of a new business-class rollout. The kind of role people take a pay cut for.

roles.title: IFE Content Acquisition Lead
roles.why: Negotiates directly with studios. Rare mix of media dealmaking and aviation.

roles.title: Executive Chef — Flight Kitchen
roles.why: Hub kitchen serving several premium carriers — a working chef role, not a desk.

roles.title: Connectivity Programme Manager
roles.why: Fully remote, LEO retrofit programme. Remote roles at this level almost never come up.

roles.title: Duty Free Category Manager
roles.why: Onboard and airport ranges under one buyer, in one of the fastest-growing hubs.

roles.title: Cabin Interiors Design Engineer
roles.why: Certification-side seat design. Hard skills that transfer anywhere in the industry.
